concept_thesis: This concept can only belong to Clínica Curitiba because it pairs the clinic's verified science-and-ethics promise with a simple treatment-to-scheduling path for Água Verde patients.
concept_rules: Lead with the verified beauty-and-health line and a treatment chooser.
Use a clinical wayfinding motif inspired by appointment notes, not medical stock clichés.
Set a calm humanist sans with disciplined numerals for treatment and contact clarity.
Use only official clinical/smile imagery and crop it to preserve faces and treatment context.
Retain teal as the trust anchor and introduce blush only as a humane, non-decorative accent.
Place responsible dentist, address, parking, phone, and scheduling action in a single trust corridor.
factual_claim_sources: Official homepage and official asset URLs; treatment, location, responsible dentist, phone, email, and parking claims are source-bounded to that page.
